scope_notes.summary: Northern PNG editorial reach is separate from the seasonally reversing surface New Guinea Coastal Current. The source uses boreal labels south of the equator; its local 150–250 m undercurrent core and ENSO shoaling do not provide annual path or width geometry. Vitiaz passage, other branches and downstream EUC lengths are excluded.

original_regional_context.display_caption: Vitiaz exit subsurface Doppler bands · source reports O(<20 km). Approximate size constraint, not a 20 km measured point or a 0–20 km range. Exact representative width, numerical uncertainty, dates and paired edges unresolved.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: Core widening by a factor of two in the central Bismarck Sea describes spatial change; no 40 km width or seasonal cycle inferred. The 200 m core, 350–400 m ADCP coverage, salinity section and speeds above 80 cm/s do not define paired width edges. Cruise 113 in the prose conflicts with 133 in Figure 3 caption; exact width occupations remain unresolved.
